title: lore agent context cannot compile a cross-repository pack: no --workspace flag
description: PLAN.md section 4.6 of the Opum Claude Code cutover specifies cross-repository grounding as: lore agent context <profile> --workspace .lore/workspaces/<manifest>.json --repository <member-id>, with identities qualified as <member-id>::<source-id>. That command does not exist. Against lore 0.4.1, passing --workspace to lore agent context fails with unknown option --workspace, and lore help agent lists only --task, --task-file, --max-tokens, --out, --force, --request and --contract. Workspace mode is implemented for query, graph, context, path and impact, but none of those is profile-scoped, so there is no way to compile a budgeted, provenance-stamped, profile-bounded evidence pack that spans repositories. An orchestrator needing evidence from more than one member has to fall back to unbounded lore context <member>::<id> calls, which is the open-ended crawl the profile mechanism exists to replace. Measured 2026-09-04 against lore 0.4.1 from both opum-agent and opum-doc. Filed from opum-agent under OPAG-33.

acceptanceCriteria.text: lore agent context accepts --workspace <manifest> and repeatable --repository <member-id>
The compiled pack qualifies source identities as <member-id>::<source-id> and stamps provenance per member
The allowed-source catalog reports selection and omission per member, so a cross-repo pack is auditable the same way a single-repo one is
lore help agent documents the flags

implementationNotes: PR 1 of 2 (this commit): added tolerateMemberFailures to loadWorkspaceProjection (src/core/workspace-source.ts) -- an opt-in per-member skip-and-report path, off by default so query/graph/context/path/impact keep today's fail-fast contract unchanged. A skipped member's own authored links are dropped too (their endpoint's export no longer exists), and an all-members-fail load still rejects outright. New LoadedWorkspaceProjection.skippedMembers field (always empty unless the option is set). 4 new tests in test/workspace-retrieval.test.ts covering: a mismatched member skipped+reported, zero-skip parity with the default path, all-fail rejection, and the pre-existing fail-fast behavior unchanged when the option is omitted. Not yet wired into any command -- PR 2 adds agent context --workspace/--repository on top of this primitive.
